title: Make the fresh-index lifecycle self-test relaunch correctly from a dotnet-tool pwsh shim
outcome: Make the fresh-index lifecycle self-test relaunch correctly from a dotnet-tool pwsh shim
acceptance: The self-test still launches the lease probe through the same PowerShell runtime and preserves its collision assertions
pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/test-roslyn-mcp.ps1 -SelfTestFreshIndexLifecycleContract passes when pwsh is installed as a dotnet global tool whose current process executable is dotnet.exe
